artboards.title: Capital projects — a matrix with forbidden cells
Call analytics — one grid, two margins
The live pack — one vendor answers, one declines
An unconnected city — built, and no source

annotations.text:
TWO REGIONS OF DIFFERENT UNITS, AND THAT IS THE LENS.
src/domains.mjs registers exactly two domains under lensId public-works: cip-projects (Capital projects, gatedBy powerbi) and call-analytics (Call analytics, gatedBy goto).
A capital project is one row per project. A call figure is one bucket per queue per relative day, and the domain says so in its own words: "this domain is the one whose RECORD IS NOT AN EVENT".
The product stacks both on one page. They switch here instead, reusing the DS tab pattern, because a 16-row register above a 25-bucket grid puts the second region below the fold and the staff who live in call handling never reach their own page. PROPOSED CHANGE, stated in the README.

FOUR STATES IN ONE GRID.
STATUS_PHASES in src/domains/cip-projects.mjs declares which phases each status may sit in: a complete project is in closeout and nothing else, a stalled one is anywhere except closeout.
So eight of the twenty cells CANNOT OCCUR BY RULE, four are a measured zero, and eight carry a count. Drawing the eight forbidden cells as zeros would put eight invented readings into a grid and make the register look like it has holes in it.
Absent, zero and unmeasured are three different states. This grid needs a fourth.

NO FIGURE OF MONEY APPEARS ON THIS LENS AT ALL.
A capital improvement register is a budget document everywhere else. This one carries no budget, no spend, no percent of budget and no encumbrance, and the domain states the refusal rather than leaving an omission:
"a money number beside a city name is a claim about that city's finances".
src/adapters.mjs declares budget on the reporting shape as a field a generated record never carries. check.mjs refuses a money token on any board in this folder.

THE TWO TABLES ARE TWO MARGINS OF ONE GRID.
The product renders "By queue" and "By relative day" as separate tables. They are not two datasets: they are the row margin and the column margin of the same 25 buckets, and both sum to 2,365.
Two numbers that should agree and are never shown agreeing is a reconciliation nobody performs. Drawn once, with both margins and the corner total, the agreement is the visible property.
One bucket carries an abandoned count of exactly ZERO. That is a reading, not an empty cell.

THE GRID DOES NOT SURVIVE THE CUTOVER, AND THE BOARD SAYS SO.
composeRealCallAnalytics in src/vendor-live.mjs maps ONE aggregate record: all queues, today. The 5x5 grid is a property of the generated pack.
A design that shipped the grid silently would promise staff a per-queue breakdown the live vendor does not expose.
The live record also carries answerRate straight from the vendor, which the generated record deliberately refuses ("a ratio without its denominator beside it"). One product, two paths, opposite rules. Raised in the README.

THE OBSTACLE IS NAMED, AND SO IS ITS KIND.
Both regions are built, granted and wired to a live feed through REAL_LIVE_DOMAINS. One vendor answers and one declines, and the reasons are not the same kind of reason: a recorded 2026-09-03 reading has Power BI returning data and GoTo returning goto_not_authorized because a human has never completed the consent flow.
So the blocked card states four things and never fewer: the state, the basis VERBATIM, what KIND of thing would move it, and when it was last read.
Across this lane: a consent, an entitlement, and a source that does not exist. Three lenses, three obstacles, three kinds.

A RECORDED READING IS NOT A CURRENT ONE.
No live probe was run for this design and no credential was used. The 2026-09-03 states are badged RECORDED with their date and their source file, and the record count renders UNREAD rather than as a number.
A canvas that printed a count would be asserting a live read it never performed. Unmeasured is its own state, including when the thing unmeasured is our own claim.

EVERY PANEL HERE SAYS THE REGION IS BUILT.
On an unconnected city both regions print the composer's own sentence, verbatim: "empty-city generates no records and no adapter is granted on it".
That sentence is the one Parks may not borrow. It tells a city it needs a GRANT. Parks needs a vendor to exist first, and a city waiting for a grant that nobody can give is the exact confusion ruling 1 was written to end.
The five-state legend is the bridge: four states live in DOMAIN_STATUSES, and the fifth has no entry there on purpose.
